fixture: video





















Colours are encoded through YUV 4:2:0, so the decoded RGB is close to but not exactly
#FF0000 / #00FF00 / #0000FF. Assert with a tolerance, or assert on the dominant channel.
The measured values for this build are recorded in README.md.




?src= selects the source: data (default, inline base64 VP8/WebM),
webm (assets/color-bars.webm), mp4 (assets/color-bars.mp4, H.264),
blob (same bytes through URL.createObjectURL).
Reading the canvas mirror back may throw SecurityError because a file:// or data: source is
cross-origin to the document; the fixture records that outcome instead of hiding it.
